intent: Six transparent clay emblems; source image used only for style reference.

variants.title: 雾蓝 · 方环
variants.detail: A softly rounded SQUARE FRAME, upright horizontal and vertical sides (NOT rotated into a diamond), a large square opening at the center. Broad ceramic ribbon gently folds at four corners, with a single elegant overlapping seam near the lower right. Restrained powder/cornflower BLUE, color family #6A8CC4, deeper blue inner folds. Clear square silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original transparent PNG emblem in a coherent family of sub-agent avatars for ECA Desktop.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: reproduce the tactile matte ceramic/clay material, subtle fine pores, softly rounded broad ribbon edges, gentle upper-left studio light, restrained industrial-design feel and the high-quality sculptural depth. Create a NEW geometry and new color as specified below; do not simply recolor the reference diamond.
All six family members should feel designed by the same person. Near-frontal three-quarter view with very mild depth, upright composition, single object centered in a square canvas, equal generous padding, object occupies about 80% of canvas. Thick broad flattened ribbon with a softly rounded rectangular cross-section and calm folds/overlaps, generous open negative space. Readable silhouette as a 40–64 px icon. Fine ceramic grain, predominantly matte, broad soft highlights, natural self-shadow inside folds.
Transparent background with real alpha INCLUDING openings through the shape; no background color, no black backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow. Exactly one coherent sculptural emblem. No writing, letters, labels, eyes, face, watermark, UI, frame or extra objects. Avoid shiny plastic, glass, chrome, inflated balloon tubes, gemstones, sharp edges, intricate tangled knots, or noisy speckles.

Geometry and color for this one image:
A softly rounded SQUARE FRAME, upright horizontal and vertical sides (NOT rotated into a diamond), a large square opening at the center. Broad ceramic ribbon gently folds at four corners, with a single elegant overlapping seam near the lower right. Restrained powder/cornflower BLUE, color family #6A8CC4, deeper blue inner folds. Clear square silhouette.

variants.title: 鼠尾草 · 圆环
variants.detail: A CIRCULAR OPEN RING formed from one broad flattened ceramic ribbon, one gentle half-turn/fold on the lower-right arc, a large circular empty center. Clearly round silhouette, not a torus or rubber donut: broad ribbon surfaces and one sculptural twist. Muted SAGE GREEN, color family #8BA58E, deep green self-shadow.
